description: Functional specification: add idempotent local persistence for per-logical-LLM-call token usage while preserving existing qa.tokens.* global execution totals. Capture request/run/call IDs, effective provider/model, configured agent, validated person identity and available conversation/session correlation; unknown remains nil. StreamEvents owns reduction; Executor relays trusted context; Engine Telemetry owns persistence. Tests first: multi-turn/model/provider changes, duplicate completions, tool-only calls, terminal cumulative totals not double-counted, malformed/missing usage, anonymous actor, retries. Action reuse: extend StreamEvents/Executor/Telemetry; ProviderSpec normalization reused; local-only instrumentation, no Action or registry exposure.
